en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ibn Fazzal, from the one who mentioned it, from Bashir Al Dahhan who said, 
‘I heard Abu Al-Hassan Musa<sup>asws</sup> saying:
‘Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Majestic and Mighty Hates the sleeping and the leisurely servant’.
en.sarwar: 2. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from ibn Faddal from the one whom he has mentioned (in his book) from Bashir al-Dahhan who has said the following: “I heard abu al-Hassan, Musa, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, saying, ’
Allah, most Majestic, most Glorious, dislikes an excessively sleeping servant who passes his time without work.’”
